name: product-viz
title: Product window
description: A product as a small window: search's question and best passage, a source syncing, a file parsed to Markdown, an embedding's values as bars, results reranked into a new order.
use_for: The website's product cards and the header's product menu, one window per product (`id`: search, sync, parse, embed, rerank).
never: A window for a product that is not one of the five
Running while off screen: set `active` only while it is in view

import type { CSSProperties } from 'react' import { cn } from '@/react/lib/cn' import { VizWindow } from '@/react/components/visuals/VizWindow' // A product as a small window (the website's ProductViz.vue), told on the quickstart's case: search (a question and its // best passage), sync (a source writing changed issues and deleting a deleted one), parse (a runbook PDF back as // Markdown), embed (a passage and a question as vectors, drawn as bars) and rerank (three passages, the answer moved // first). Each carries its call's options as tags. The content is the website's illustration, fixed per `id`. export type ProductVizId = 'search' | 'sync' | 'parse' | 'embed' | 'rerank' export interface ProductVizProps { id: ProductVizId active: boolean /** Classes on the window's root after its own (Vue's class falling through), such as relative over a cell-burst. */ className?: string } const TITLES: Record = { search: 'POST /namespaces/docs/query', sync: 'Source Linear', parse: 'POST /parse', embed: 'POST /v1/embeddings', rerank: 'POST /v1/rerank' } // An embedding's first values, drawn as bars of their size: the shape of a vector, not its numbers. const vector = [0.62, 0.36, 0.09, 0.48, 0.21] const synced = [ { id: 'ENG-212 Key rotation fails in EU', result: 'Updated' }, { id: 'ENG-219 Add rollback runbook', result: 'Created' }, { id: 'ENG-180 Checkout timeouts', result: 'Updated' }, { id: 'ENG-97 Old signing key', result: 'Deleted', gone: true }, ] // Found in one order, reranked into another (rows' places before and after). const ranked = [ { text: 'EU checkout broke after a key rotation.', from: 1, to: 0 }, { text: 'Checkout runs in three regions.', from: 0, to: 1 }, { text: 'Rotate keys from the console.', from: 2, to: 2 }, ] const d = (n: number) => ({ '--d': n }) as CSSProperties const syncedStyles = synced.map((_, i) => d(500 + i * 300)) const vectorRows = vector.map((v, i) => ({ v, row: d(500 + i * 120), bar: { '--w': v, '--d': 600 + i * 120 } as CSSProperties })) const rankedStyles = ranked.map(r => ({ '--from': r.from, '--to': r.to, '--d': 600 + r.from * 120, '--track': '32px' }) as CSSProperties) export function ProductViz({ id, active, className }: ProductVizProps) { return ( {TITLES[id]}}>
